import calendar


def add_months(day: str, n: int) -> str:
    year, month, dom = (int(p) for p in day.split("-"))
    last_src = calendar.monthrange(year, month)[1]
    is_last = dom == last_src

    total = year * 12 + (month - 1) + n
    ty, tm_idx = divmod(total, 12)
    ty_month = tm_idx + 1
    last_tgt = calendar.monthrange(ty, ty_month)[1]

    if is_last:
        td = last_tgt
    else:
        td = min(dom, last_tgt)

    return f"{ty:04d}-{ty_month:02d}-{td:02d}"
